name: Decai Decoration Co., Ltd.
summary: Decai Decoration Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the building decoration business in China and internationally. It operates through six segments: Decai Decoration, China Construction United, China Real Estate Design, Decai High-Tech, Decai Curtain Wall, and SCO Zhongxin. The company is involved in the interior decoration, curtain wall and window, intelligent, and ancient building engineering; and construction of various buildings and ancillary facilities, as well as installation of supporting lines, pipelines, and equipment.
